```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dbscan)
library(kneedle)
library(umap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer) 
```


#Load file
```{r}
base_path = "/Users/hyoyeon/Desktop/Career/Sony/Lana/2024_12_29_17_15/OEE-data/SummaryIndividuals_45000.csv"
df = read.csv(base_path)

select_columns = c("lifeSpan", "nkids", "matForKids", "speed", "maxEnergy", 
                   "kidEnergy", "sensors", "pgmDeath")
df_stripped = df[, select_columns]
```

#Run UMAP
```{r}
set.seed(42) # Set seed for reproducibility
umap_res <- umap(df_stripped, n_components = 2)
umap_embedding <- umap_res$layout 

umap_plot_df = data.frame(UMAP1 = umap_embedding[,1], UMAP2 = umap_embedding[,2])
```

#Plot UMAP
```{r}
ggplot(umap_plot_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP Projection of Agent Attributes")
```


#elbow detection
```{r}
db_minPts = 10

select_n = 1000 # Sample size
set.seed(42)
sample_indices = sample(1:nrow(umap_embedding), select_n)
umap_sample = umap_embedding[sample_indices, ]

k_distance_umap <- kNNdist(umap_sample, k = db_minPts)
d_umap = sort(k_distance_umap)

k_dist_umap_df <- data.frame(Index = 1:length(d_umap), Distance = d_umap)

elbow_sens = 10.0 
knee_umap <- kneedle(k_dist_umap_df$Index, k_dist_umap_df$Distance, sensitivity = elbow_sens, decreasing = FALSE)
elbow_umap = knee_umap[2]

cat(paste("New epsilon (elbow) calculated from UMAP sample:", round(elbow_umap, 4), "\n"))
  
```


# Plot the k-distance graph
```{r}
ggplot(k_dist_umap_df, aes(x = Index, y = Distance)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = elbow_umap, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Sorted Index of UMAP Sample Points",
       y = paste0(db_minPts, "-Nearest Neighbor Distance in UMAP Space"),
       title = "K-Distance Plot for Epsilon Selection (UMAP Sample)")
```


#Apply DBSCAN to UMAP
```{r}
db_umap = dbscan(umap_embedding, eps = elbow_umap, minPts = db_minPts)

umap_plot_df_full <- data.frame(UMAP1 = umap_embedding[,1],
                                UMAP2 = umap_embedding[,2]) %>%
  mutate(Cluster = as.factor(db_umap$cluster))

n_clusters_umap = max(db_umap$cluster)
noise_points_umap = sum(db_umap$cluster == 0)

cat(paste("DBSCAN (on full UMAP) found", n_clusters_umap, "clusters and", noise_points_umap, "noise points (Cluster 0).\n"))
```


#Plot DBSCAN
```{r}

primary_colors <- c("red", "blue", "green", "orange", "purple", "cyan")
noise_color <- "lightgrey"


if (any(db_umap$cluster == 0)) {
  cluster_colors_umap <- c(noise_color, primary_colors[1:n_clusters_umap])
} else {
  cluster_colors_umap <- primary_colors[1:n_clusters_umap]
}
# Apply to plot
ggplot(umap_plot_df_full, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors_umap) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "UMAP Projection (colored by Cluster)",
    subtitle = paste("eps =", round(elbow_umap, 4), ", MinPts =", db_minPts,
                     "sensitivity =", elbow_sens)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))

#p <- plotly::ggplotly(g, tooltip = c("x", "y", "colour"))

```

#Save it
```{r}
frame <- list(
  x = umap_plot_df_full$UMAP1,
  y = umap_plot_df_full$UMAP2,
  cluster = as.character(umap_plot_df_full$Cluster)
)

 cluster_output <- data.frame(
    id = df$ID,
    Cluster = db_umap$cluster
  )
write.csv(cluster_output, "umap_res/Summary_45000.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```
